tasks.label: 宽版错位障碍路段
tasks.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL game-ready modular toy race track design reference, not based on any existing game or copyrighted screenshot. Single isolated complete modular road section, neutral light gray background, soft studio light, high oblique three-quarter view with every endpoint and complete route visible, no cropping, no text, no watermark, no collage, no characters. Design language: clean continuous ivory molded-polymer deck, solid muted petrol-teal rounded guardrails, pale yellow connectors, coral foam obstacles; no wooden planks, no rainbow-block fences. Precise usable flat road surfaces and clearly separated moving pieces; restrained simple chunky toy shapes. Track travel from back to front. Working design proportions: 19.2 units clear usable width, about 30 units long. Show underside thickness and small low support feet. An original wide slalom obstacle section: a single straight continuous wide road, six staggered low capsule-shaped foam bumpers arranged as three alternating pairs, broad readable gaps between them, low solid continuous sidewalls. Smooth ramp-free connections at both ends. Each coral capsule bumper has a pale-yellow recessed endcap, no spikes or peg forest. Entire object should look manufacturable and easy to reconstruct as simple collision shapes.
